visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens inside a brightly lit Japanese drugstore with symmetrical aisles of cosmetic shelves. A hand enters the frame holding a gold-packaged sunscreen product against the backdrop of organized retail displays. (2) The perspective shifts to a specific display for 'THE FLOWER SHOP'. A hand picks up a beige tube of makeup base, rotating it to show the texture; large posters of models are visible in the background. (3) Transition to a hair care section featuring 'THE ANSWER' series. A hand selects a silver-and-purple tube of shampoo from a dense display of various colored bottles under bright fluorescent lighting. (4) The camera focuses on 'ANESSA' products. A hand demonstrates a brush-on powder applicator, twisting the cap to reveal the bristles and then brushing the powder onto the back of another hand to show the finish. (5) A close-up shot features an 'excel' brand powder compact with a light blue, pearlescent shell-like texture. The compact is held and tilted to catch the light. (6) The scene moves to a 'CANMAKE' display. Multiple small pump bottles of makeup base are shown in pink and beige shades; a hand picks up one bottle for a close-up inspection. (7) The final phase is a graphic screen with a pink background, featuring a large QR code, various social media icons (Facebook, Instagram, YouTube), and a logo for 'Japanuts'.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 2025年3月號 日本藥妝 近期新品. [Logo]: 日本失心瘋. (2) [Slogan]: THE FLOWER SHOP 校色妝前乳. [Subtitle]: 這是佐田真由美 創辦的新美妝品牌. 偏水感的前乳 非常好推! 很貼合肌膚. 他們家強調自然感 顯色度都不是太高喔. (3) [Slogan]: THE ANSWER 塗抹式洗髮. [Subtitle]: 這系列加入5大美髮成分 聽說媲美沙龍級修護. 針對不同髮質 有推出三個系列 效果我還蠻喜歡的 正在找髮品可以參考! (4) [Slogan]: ANESSA 刷具 + 防曬粉 2合1. [Subtitle]: 安耐曬最新話題商品就是這個了! 主打不弄髒手、不黏膩 帶妝也可以補防曬. 方便度很不錯 刷頭還可以拆下來清潔喔. (5) [Slogan]: excel 限定防曬粉餅. [Subtitle]: 水藍色貝殼紋的外殼 超!級!美! 上臉不會太乾 秋冬用也很ok. (6) [Slogan]: CANMAKE 保濕校色妝前乳. [Subtitle]: 這款也是屬於質地水潤的妝前乳. 上妝後真的就像海報上說的 很有透明感. 一共推出兩個色號 一罐只要990日幣 CP值非常高. (7) [Variety]: 哪一款你最有興趣? 留言告訴我. (8) [Slogan]: 掃描上方 QR code 看「2025年藥妝必買清單」. [Logo]: 日本失心瘋 japanuts.com.

It utilizes a first-person 'shopping' perspective to showcase product packaging and textures, providing brief evaluative commentary via on-screen text to guide potential consumers' purchasing decisions.
